lanes.note: Income-first pivot lane (set 2026-07-29). The fit scorer marks these 50-64 because the candidate lacks DIRECT IT-support history, which is exactly what a pivot means, so the global floor of 65 was rejecting the whole lane while senior AI roles cleared it and then got rejected by employers in 48h. Geography is an explicit GO-commutable city list on purpose: bare 'ontario'/'canada' would pull in Ottawa and Thunder Bay, and bare 'remote' would pull in worldwide-remote support roles, which are a different and far more crowded market.
